subject.title: BL-ecommerce-product: Product Page — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should the Product Page block continue through F1/F2 now with MiguelHamelyn validating all rules and flags before any F3/F4 isolation?
rationale: The repository BL process makes owner validation of each business rule a blocking human step, and current `dev` has no Product Page BL artifacts yet.

options.title: Continue F1/F2 first
options.body: MiguelHamelyn validates the extracted Product Page rules and flags, then the implementer isolates and tests only validated behavior while leaving divergences in linked issues.

options.title: Split the block
options.body: If extraction confirms the block is larger than a healthy BL spin, the owner should split it into smaller Product Page sub-blocks before isolation.

options.title: Pause behind divergences
options.body: The team can wait for the open Product Page divergence issues to settle before validating final BL specs, at the cost of delaying the mother block.

recommendation.title: Continue F1/F2 first
recommendation.body: MiguelHamelyn validates the extracted Product Page rules and flags, then the implementer isolates and tests only validated behavior while leaving divergences in linked issues.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the named owner and current assignee, and they have recent Product Page implementation history.
